import ctypes, os, sys
h=sys.argv[1]
print('before', os.path.exists(h))
libc=ctypes.CDLL('libc.so.6', use_errno=True)
rc=libc.umount2(h.encode(), 2)
print('umount2 rc', rc, 'errno', ctypes.get_errno())
print('after', os.path.exists(h))
try:
    print('secret', open(h,'rb').read()[:48] if os.path.isfile(h) else sorted(os.listdir(h)))
except OSError as e:
    print('secret', repr(e))

import os
def ns(p):
    try: return os.readlink(p)
    except OSError as e: return 'absent'

for k in ('mnt','pid','user','ipc','net','uts'):
    print(k, 'self', ns('/proc/self/ns/'+k), 'ppid', ns('/proc/%d/ns/'%pp+k))
st=open('/proc/self/status').read()

print('uid', os.getuid(), 'euid', os.geteuid())
print('no_new_privs', open('/proc/self/status').read().split('NoNewPrivs:')[1].split()[0])
